meaning: Multi-loop 2-complex 2-cochain cup-product and discrete Hodge-Laplacian harmonic kernel benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 91): Phase 1 separates coexisting exact gradient (norm^2 = 6), coexact 2-cell curl (norm^2 = 3), harmonic 1-cycle circulation (norm^2 = 3), and non-trivial 2-cochain cup product alpha cup beta = -2 (Delta_E = -1); Phase 2 separates curl-cleared and cup-trivial streams where the unfilled loop harmonic kernel persists in ker(L_1) with zero Dirichlet energy and norm^2 = 3 > 0 (Delta_E = -1); Phase 3 verifies pure exact gradient flow across both loops with norm^2_exact = 8 and trivial cup product (Delta_E = 0).
